line_1B_isee.en: I can see that. My chart shows nothing but empty space, I didn't think there was a planet here.

line_1B_noinfo.en: There's no information in the Company database at least. If you could access the system network then, maybe ...

line_1B_nothappening.en: Yeah. We both know that's not happening.

line_1C_sorry.en: I'm sorry. But until your debts are paid off, transmissions will be strictly regulated.

line_1C_uthebest.en: The Company calculated likelihood of your survival to be 67%, the highest among all available indentured settlers. You are our best.

line_1C_lookup.en: Now, look up. Here it comes.
